title: Ed May leads Stargate research in its final decade

plain: A writer named Eric Wargo tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Stargate, a secret US government programme that studied psychic abilities like seeing distant places with the mind. Wargo says a scientist named Ed May took over the research side of the programme from physicist Hal Puthoff and led it through its final decade, from about 1985 until it was made public and supposedly ended in 1995. The word "supposedly" hints that it may have carried on in some form.
